car.name: Ember Pod Prototype
car.description: Original fictional mid-engine prototype inspired by TAMO Racemo. Uses 800 kg development TARGET, not measured curb weight; six-speed paddle gearbox ratios are modeled, not verified production specifications.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: TAMO Racemo petrol concept / production-intent prototype, no production model year asserted

verifiedFacts.transmission: TA6300 AMT, six forward one reverse, paddle shift

modelledAssumptions.massClassification: reported development target, NOT measured curb mass

gearing.classification: bespoke simulation design, NOT Racemo or Nexon component specification
gearing.designCriterion: sixth chosen for220km/h at6500rpm with nominal rear radius.33435m;220km/h is selected game design target, not OEM top-speed claim

estimates: 800kg is reported development target with uncertain achievement; no primary measured curb mass. This car is a prototype-target simulation, not a verified production trim.

All six individual gear ratios, final4.1 and reverse3.1 are explicitly modelled. Sixth derived from chosen220km/h@6500rpm kinematic design target; lower ratios selected for progressive spacing. No Nexon gearing borrowed or represented as Racemo verified.

Manufacturer190PS converted to mechanical hp;210Nm converted tolbft.6500rpm torque derived from rated power. Other curve samples, idle/redline/revlimit, shift timing, launch control, losses and gear control are estimates.

TA6300AMT six-forward/one-reverse manufacturer fact; current runtime manual shift mode approximates paddle operation with zero clutch delay. Does not claim detailed AMT actuator or automated clutch physics.

Staggered205/50R17 front and235/45R18 rear are source facts. Runtime car uses single tire-size/radius: rear driven-wheel235/45R18 and.33435m nominal radius, so front sizing approximated. Front nominal.3184m preserved as provenance; no claim true staggered runtime geometry.

40%front distribution is secondary reported/assumed, not manufacturer measured. Tracks1.50/1.51m,CG.46m,collidersections,overhangsplit,steering15:1,drag.36,grip,brakes,differential,suspension and pressure30psi are simulation estimates.
220km/h top-speed and6s0-60 are provisional game design targets, not measured performance. No Forza gameplay stats used as real-world evidence.

Wheel anchors measured visually and from transparent openings; front/rear anchors inferred behind shell corners. Artwork and placement are original fictional design, not factory replica. Browser/driving QA pending.

Visual wheel calibration: oblique hub centers remeasured within source transparent openings, then vertical upper opening extent plus2px used for cover radius. Only sprite transforms change; physical tires and drivetrain unchanged.
catalogProvenance.artwork: Original logo-free red/black Ember Pod coupe and cockpit; shared existing steeringwheel reused.
